profile_text.body:
Dynatrace, Inc. describes itself on its website as an observability platform built for the age of AI. The company says it combines observability, AI, automation, and application security in one platform, and calls itself the AI-powered observability leader. Its site quotes Stephen Elliot, Group Vice President at IDC, as saying the future of observability is preventive and autonomous, using deterministic AI and AI agents to coordinate actions across cloud platforms, developer tools, and IT service management. A customer quote on the site says Dynatrace's AI engine provides early detection of potential system issues without false alarms, reducing root cause identification from hours to minutes.

Public records identify the company as Dynatrace, Inc., also styled DYNATRACE INC, headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts. It is a for-profit public company traded under the ticker DT, with CIK number 0001773383. Massachusetts legal exposure data lists 191 entries under the company's name.
